Priority order for next session: (1) Inspect daily-logger run log at https://github.com/ojfbot/daily-logger/actions/runs/41267355441 — determine which of the three failure branches applies before any other editorial action. (2) Confirm whether October 31 (#515) and November 1 (#516) failure states are independent or compounding. (3) If pipeline is clean or transient fault confirmed, merge daily-logger #519. (4) Disposition morning-cockpit #60 — twelve days open with no stated intent. (5) Schedule a workstation-yuri review session to begin closing the three review-only PRs (#8, #9, #10) and advancing the four documentation drafts.

Evidence gaps: ADR-0035 is cited as governing the pipeline-alert behavior; its existence as a dated, written document with a rationale section is not confirmed from available evidence — it may be a retroactive label. The fleet manifest's file path is not surfaced in this article; BookcaseDiscovery's absence from it is stated but the manifest location is not cited. Whether "review-only" posture on workstation-yuri PRs #8, #9, #10 is enforced by branch protection/labels or is a social contract in the PR description is unconfirmed. morning-cockpit #60 open duration is approximately 12 days based on the 2026-10-21 date in the PR description; exact open date not independently verified.

Owner gates: daily-logger #519 merge awaits human editorial decision after #516 diagnostic. workstation-yuri review-only PRs await a scheduled review session. core #572 awaits a review pass before promotion to ready state.
